verdicts.reason: Both demote the RSVP CTA to a tiny pill lost among the badges, blow the grey placeholder image up into the largest block on the right, and shrink the legal text to an illegible size, so neither has a clear hierarchy. A also wraps the italic tagline into a cramped four-line column and leaves 'June' orphaned on its own line. B keeps the tagline and 'Saturday 21 June' on one line each, but crushes '6 pm, Harbour Rooftop' into a narrow three-line stack jammed against the pills. B is slightly cleaner overall.
